scripts.audit:security: npm run audit:root && npm run audit:web
scripts.audit:security:all: npm audit --audit-level=moderate && cd web && npm audit --audit-level=moderate
scripts.deps:review: npm run audit:security:all; audit_status=$?; npm run deps:freshness; freshness_status=$?; if [ "$freshness_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$freshness_status"; fi; if [ "$audit_status" -ne 0 ]; then echo "audit:security:all reported advisory moderate/dev findings; required production gate is npm run audit:security"; fi
scripts.web:test:control-room: npm run web:test:dashboardview && npm run web:test:cardsview && npm run web:test:agentsview && npm run web:test:filesview && npm run web:test:debugview
scripts.web:test:debugview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/debug-view
scripts.web:test:cardsview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/cards-view
scripts.web:test:agentsview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/agents-view

scripts.web:test:filesview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/files-view

scripts.web:test:store:sync: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/sync-client.test.ts
scripts.web:test:store:cards: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/card-store.test.ts
scripts.web:test:store:files: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/files-store.test.ts

scripts.validate:routine: npm run typecheck && npm run docs:verify
scripts.validate:ui: npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test:sweep && npm run web:test:operator-smoke
scripts.validate:release: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run web:test:operator-smoke && npm run docs:verify
